title: Precise Playwright selection and editor debugging integration
summary: Runtime discovery identifies exact tests and verifies unambiguous selection before launch from checkout-specific editor settings.

dates.note: Exact project start/end dates remain unknown. Direct local source/history review on 2026-10-29 supplements the supplied October 5 snapshot and separately dated owner statements. Commit milestones and review dates are not project starts or release dates.

facts.text: Integrated VS Code debugging with checkout-specific workspace slots, Playwright projects and test files while preserving surrounding launch configuration.
Built a precise Playwright test picker using public reporter discovery, escaped anchored title filters and a second discovery pass requiring exactly the selected test ID.
Canceled safely on ambiguity, collection failure or interruption; handled parameterized/nested tests, tags and punctuation without parsing test declarations or silently broadening selection.
Implemented MCP/Electron proof tooling for JSON-RPC initialization, required-tool discovery, renderer identity, evidence capture and owned-process cleanup.

notes: Live discovery followed by a second exact-ID discovery is the mechanism supporting selection; this evidence strengthens the existing selection/ambiguity facts instead of adding a duplicate accomplishment.
